treatment: PDF paths retained unchanged; wordmark downscaled from the 3766x852 original to 1000x226 for release (linear factor 3.77x) and that same file embedded in the logo SVG; proportional placement on a white background. Downscaling was required to keep the WeChat mini-program main package under its 2 MB limit: the original embedded unchanged produced a 2.45 MB package, which the platform refuses. The archived original in this directory is never modified and is protected by the sha256 above.
